## Body

For ddocs-only delta reviews, compare the old/new canonical JSON by section name and row ID before reading generated table diffs. Long `.dd.md` table rows repeatedly truncated tool output during #238; canonical field comparisons exposed the actual changes without rereading unchanged paragraphs.

Then run read-only `ddocs validate` and check changed text against the generated faces, accounting for HTML entities and escaped table pipes. Text presence is a bounded consistency check, not full rendering or semantic proof. Never regenerate or edit a frozen review worktree just to inspect it.

The existing #238/#239 notes retain the findings, repairs and proof limits; this note adds only the review technique.
